description: This file contains a definition of a specialized Triton kernel class, 'TritonSplitScanKernel', which generates GPU kernels to perform scan (prefix sum) operations with splitting over multiple Triton programs. It includes methods for initialization, range setup, and scan execution, leveraging Triton and sympy for symbolic computation and code generation.

classes.name: TritonSplitScanKernel
classes.description: A class that generates Triton GPU kernels supporting scan operations with reduction splitting, managing range trees and communication between thread blocks.
